materialChanges: Reframed summary statistics as provisional shape warnings throughout the objective, instruction, practice, transfer, assessment answers, and rubric, with a required plot or raw-data check before concluding shape.

Added the complete invented observations behind both histograms and recomputed the bin counts, quartiles, ranges, means, sample standard deviations, group summaries, and intervention total from those inspectable values.

Narrowed the symmetry claim to explicit mean-existence, unique-median, and unimodality conditions; made the normal IQR-to-SD ratio nonspecific; and distinguished exact-value sample modes from modal intervals and population-density modes.
Removed the unsupported clinical interpretation of the extreme invented observation and replaced it with an investigate-before-retain-or-exclude boundary.
Added a self-explanation prompt to the hand-worked standard-deviation example and classified the clinical wrap-up as synthesis.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The shape objective now treats summaries as provisional warnings. The misconception check, faded practice, mastery item, answer variants, and five-point rubric require uncertainty plus a histogram, suitable observation plot, or ordered raw data before a shape conclusion.

The 1.35 value is retained only as an asymptotic normal reference. Spread, misconception, practice, transfer, assessment, claim uncertainty, and glossary language now state that departures are nonspecific and cannot distinguish skew, heavy or light tails, truncation, or separated groups.

The claim, mapped scenes, source notes, reference-use record, attribution, and glossary now distinguish mean and unique-median coincidence under symmetry from the additional unimodal central-mode condition, and state that summary agreement does not establish shape.
The worked example now says only that its mean and median happen to agree and explicitly requires ordered-spacing or plot inspection before any shape claim.

Thirty exact observations per dinner group now yield means 137.5 and 146.5 mg/dL, equal sample standard deviations 17.569 mg/dL, and a pooled sample standard deviation 18.001 mg/dL. The wrap-up reports 17.6 and 18.0 after rounding and recomputes the standardized difference as 0.512, about 0.51.

Adjacent Markdown tables now expose every invented observation behind both charts. Independent pack-local recalculation reproduced all 60 observations per chart, every declared bin count, the cohort and clinic means, medians, midpoint quartiles, extrema, sample standard deviations, and the 720 mg/dL intervention-total change.

The centre scene, glossary, claim uncertainty, and assessment reasoning now distinguish an exact-value sample mode from modal histogram intervals and continuous population-density modes, including the possibility of several peaks.

The invented 382 mg/dL observation now carries no clinical interpretation. The lesson states that an extreme value may be valid or may reflect measurement, transcription, or protocol error and must be investigated before retention or exclusion.
The note independently confirmed the assessment item's mean, squared-deviation total, sample variance, sample standard deviation, and unit. The keyed numerical answer remains unchanged.
A learner-facing self-explanation prompt now closes the hand-worked example by asking why unsquared deviations cancel and how squaring turns them into a usable spread calculation.
The clinical wrap-up scene kind is now synthesis, matching its comparison, reporting-choice, and boundary function without pretending it is another stepwise worked example.
This was a positive first-read note with no requested repair. The concrete opener, relevance, prerequisite route, and plain-language statement of the central task were preserved.

This was a positive transfer-design note with no requested repair. The two-cluster transfer structure and its demand for model selection were preserved, while the academic review's invalid ratio diagnostic was corrected.

evidenceChecked: All eight scenes retain one level-one heading, ordered level-two sections, manifest reading order, balanced declarative directives, and learner-visible source notes for every mapped claim.

The two charts retain concise alt text and detailed long descriptions, and now have adjacent Markdown tables with every exact observation; no conclusion depends on colour, hover, animation, sound, drag, timing, or screen position.
Checks present prompts before feedback, use no timed or pointer-only operation, and retain prerequisite recovery, practice recovery, and nonvisual arithmetic routes.
Mathematics remains dollar-delimited TeX with prose interpretation and contains no raw HTML, entity workaround, unsafe command, script, remote embed, or executable content.

Every cohort, clinic, intervention, audit, and trial is labelled or governed as invented teaching data; no identifiable patient, learner, credential, secret, personal medical record, or self-testing direction appears.

All six retained sources use HTTPS, facts-only original-expression records, dated agent-access checks, and no human-only status; the one CC BY source records its licence, and sources with no displayed licence are used only for facts.

The lesson declares CC BY 4.0, has no third-party assets or redistributed datasets, identifies the accountable principal and author run, preserves the two unchanged review artifacts, and discloses the fresh finalizer in this adjudication.
limitations: No rendered browser, keyboard-only, screen-reader, 200-percent zoom/reflow, contrast, MathML, print, or planned non-web export test was run; the audit is based on the static Markdown, chart JSON, and structured pack.

The operator prohibited reading site schemas and running npm, so public-schema validation, strict source preflight, repository validation, and pull-request provenance checks were not run in this finalizer environment. Pack-local JSON parsing, identity/linkage, heading/directive, raw-HTML/entity, accepted-response-type, rights-ledger, rubric-point, and arithmetic checks passed.

Source pages and current terms were not independently re-opened in this run. The audit relies on the pack's dated access records and preserves the academic review's limitation that the PubMed Central article could not be reopened in that review environment.

The attribution discloses that an excluded OpenStax source was opened before its terms were checked. It was removed from every retained reference, claim, source note, example, and dependency; this audit did not independently reconstruct that earlier access.

The same accountable GitHub principal operates the authoring, review, and finalizer runs. Agent run IDs and declared providers are distinct where required, but provenance is self-attested and does not establish independent human review.

rationale: The exact original candidate and both eligible advisory reviews were read in full. The review-input gate is satisfied on the supplied record by one academic and one learning-design artifact against the same candidate, across two distinct run IDs and declared provider/model families; both are request-changes inputs, so the snapshot contains zero approvals and two change requests. Every indexed finding is disposed above. The bounded final revision resolves all major academic and learning-design defects while preserving the successful opener and transfer structure. Exact invented data now make the central arithmetic reproducible, assessment logic matches the narrowed objective, claims and source notes carry the corrected boundaries, and the static accessibility-and-rights audit found no unresolved content, access, privacy, security, attribution, or reuse blocker. The remaining limitations concern unperformed environment-level checks, self-attested provenance, and the documented excluded-source access sequence rather than retained teaching content. On that evidence, merge is appropriate once the operator stamps the final commit and runtime identity and the required repository and pull-request checks pass.
dissent: Both eligible advisory reviews returned request-changes on the original candidate. Their major findings are incorporated, but neither reviewer evaluated the final edit; the fresh finalizer is accountable for it under the one-pass standard policy.

The learning-design review declared principal-level conflict because VSBDev operates the authoring and review agents. The academic artifact declared no conflict, but the records still show one accountable principal across roles; founding-stage policy permits this without making it independent human verification.
conditions: The operator must commit the final lesson content, replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character SHA, and stamp the four RUNTIME-STAMPED adjudicator identity fields from the runtime banner without changing teaching content.
